transcript: Speaker A: क्या कर रहे हो? [What are you doing?] Speaker B: I is going office. Speaker A: I am going to office बोलना चाहिए। [You should say, 'I am going to office.'] Speaker B: I am going to office. Speaker A: Better. I am heading to office. Lakhs of people are using it.] Speaker B: Nice, मैं अभी डाउनलोड करता हूँ। [Nice, I will download it right now.] Speaker C: अभी Speakeasy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Kya Kar Rahe [What are you doing] / I Is Going Office / I Am Going To Office / I Am Heading To Office / Mujhe Bhi English Bolni [I also want to speak English] / Bas Pandrah Minute Daily Practice Se Start Karo [Just start with fifteen minutes of daily practice] / Bahut Paise Lagenge [Will it cost a lot of money] / Nahi, Sirf Ek Rupaye Se Full Access Trial Start Hota Hai [No, the full access trial starts at just one rupee] / Lakhon Log Use Kar Rahe Hain [Lakhs of people are using it] / Nice, Main Abhi Download Karta [Nice, I will download it right now] / Speakeasy AI / Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy / Install Now
summary: An AI avatar corrects a man's English grammar in a split-screen format, promoting the Speakeasy app. She highlights that users can practice for 15 minutes daily with a trial starting at just 1 rupee. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for fluent English.
